# Optim Toldos

> Solar protection and outdoor-living specialists in Alicante: bespoke awnings,
> bioclimatic pergolas, glass curtains, shade sails and PVC windows. 15+ years
> of experience, 2,000+ installations, custom manufacturing and professional
> installation across the entire Costa Blanca. Bilingual EN/ES site.

Optim Toldos is a company based in Elche (Alicante) with more than 15 years of experience designing, manufacturing and installing solar protection and enclosure solutions for homes and businesses across the province of Alicante and the Costa Blanca. More than 2,000 installations completed.

## Services

- [Bespoke awnings](https://optimtoldos.com/en/awnings/): cool the terrace by up to 15 °C and block over 90 % of UV radiation. Retractable, vertical, drop-arm, hood and window models. Acrylic and waterproof fabrics, optional motorisation, protective cassette, 200+ colours.
- [Bioclimatic pergolas](https://optimtoldos.com/en/pergolas/): turn the terrace into a 365-day-a-year usable space. Aluminium with adjustable 0°–135° louvres, smart motorisation, integrated LED lighting, automatic rain sensor.
- [Glass curtains](https://optimtoldos.com/en/glass-curtains/): enclose the terrace without losing the view; raise interior temperature 5–8 °C above outside on sunny days. 8–10 mm tempered safety glass, full folding without vertical frames, acoustic insulation.
- [Shade sails](https://optimtoldos.com/en/shade-sails/): create lightweight shaded zones with certified 95 % UV protection and up to 50 °C temperature reduction beneath the sail. Triangular, rectangular and bespoke shapes. 10+ year service life.
- [PVC windows and doors](https://optimtoldos.com/en/pvc-windows/): up to 70 % less heat loss and acoustic insulation up to 47 dB, with average 30–40 % savings on heating/cooling. Sliding, casement and tilt-and-turn. CE certified.

- [Glass curtains guide](https://optimtoldos.com/en/glass-curtains-guide/): glass thickness, folding systems, maintenance and combinations.
- [Awning prices in Alicante 2026](https://optimtoldos.com/en/awning-prices-alicante-2026/): up-to-date price ranges by awning type, dimensions and extras.
- [Awning maintenance on the Costa Blanca](https://optimtoldos.com/en/awning-maintenance-costa-blanca/): recommended annual routine for coastal climate, salt and wind.
- [Awnings for residents' communities in Alicante](https://optimtoldos.com/en/awnings-residents-communities-alicante/): façade-uniformity rules, voting and standard documentation.

## Indicative pricing

- Retractable awnings: from €350 up to €1,500+ depending on dimensions, fabric, motorisation and cassette.
- Bioclimatic pergolas: from €3,000 up to €12,000+ depending on dimensions, finishes and lighting.
- Glass curtains: from €250 to €450 per m² depending on height, glass thickness and panel count.
- Bespoke shade sails: from €200 up to €1,500 depending on size, material and anchoring.
- PVC windows: average 30–40 % savings on heating/cooling (€300–600/year for an average home in Alicante).

All quotes are free and no-obligation, and include an on-site visit for exact measurements.
